visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens on an outdoor urban sidewalk at night. A group of seven young adults is positioned for a performance. In the foreground, a male in a black cap and t-shirt holds his face with both hands, looking surprised. To his right, a female with vibrant pink hair and glasses smiles brightly. Several other males in white and black casual wear stand in the background. (2) As the dance begins, the group performs synchronized movements. They lean forward and back in unison, keeping their legs slightly bent. The lighting is provided by street lamps and the glow from nearby high-rise buildings. (3) The camera pulls back to a wider shot, revealing the full scale of the group. They transition into a sequence where they raise their hands above their heads and swing them rhythmically. The background features a large building with a red neon sign that reads '約有寶石'. (4) The center male and the pink-haired female take more active roles in the choreography, moving with high energy while the dancers behind them maintain the synchronized foundation. Their expressions are joyful and focused. (5) The group moves collectively toward the camera, increasing the visual intensity. They perform a series of quick hand gestures and chest pops. (6) The video concludes with the group striking a final pose. Some members give a 'thumbs up' or 'ok' sign while others maintain a cool, confident expression toward the lens.
